text:
Tara: Heads-up: several customers ask for a clear recommendation - messages vs prompt. Need to finalize roadmap and launch criteria today.

Eli: Proposal: messages-first API (array of {role,content}) as default. Keep a prompt compatibility header for 6 months.

Priya: Requirements from CS: immutable system role, function calling with explicit schemas, and opt-in structured JSON validation.

Eli: Runtime note: messages enable role-aware KV caching which helps chats. Prompt has better single-request batching. Supporting both is extra QA cost.

Tara: Minimal launch checklist: messages payload + SDKs, admin system_pin, functions array + function_call policy, opt-in response_format=json_schema:v1, docs+migration guide.

Priya: Add telemetry for schema failures and pilot acceptance: two pilots (startup + enterprise) with >95% schema pass when enabled.

build-bot: deploy: canary messages-api v1 rolling out in us-east-1 (build 2026.06.01-rc2).

Tara: Action items: I'll draft RFC; @Eli scope infra impact; @Priya prototype validation and examples. RFC by EOD.

Eli: on it.

Priya: will prototype this week.
